newsitem.title: USA: Nextel to reveal pricing strategy - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Nextel to reveal pricing strategy - WSJ.

text.p: Nextel Communications Inc plans to reveal a new pricing strategy that charges customers based on each second of usage, the Wall Street Journal said in its Monday electronic edition.
The current practice is to round up charges to the next minute, the report said, and Nextel's move could challenge rivals in the wireless market to cut rates.
The report said the McLean, Viriginia-based company is also cutting the price of its newest phone by about 50 percent, to $199 from $399.
